title: Metadata, Data Quality & Cleaning
code: Chapter 2 · Digital data and data analysis
html:
AP Computer Science Principles

Data Quality
& Cleaning

元数据 · 数据质量 · 清洗记录

90 minutes · Metadata, context and defensible decisions
note: 本课关注分析前的决策：这些值是什么意思，来自哪里，哪些行适合当前问题，改动如何记录。课程使用虚构自愿通勤调查，所有数据为合成教学数据，不代表真实学生或调查发现。不要提前用均值、图表吸引学生删掉不喜欢的记录；统计比较留给 L08。

title: Retrieve the idea of context
html:
1. 00001100 represents which nonnegative integer?
    Do those bits alone tell you whether it means minutes?
  2. A survey receives “Bus” and later displays a count.
    Identify an input, processing, and an output.
Show answers
1. 12. An agreed meaning or context is needed to interpret it as minutes.
2. Input: “Bus”. Processing: counting responses. Output: the displayed count.
note: 先独立写，再同桌解释为什么算出 12 还不足以知道它的现实含义。第二题同时复习 L02 的输入、处理与输出。这里不要求重复位权全部教学；把“解释需要上下文”接到元数据。

title: What will make the data usable?
html:
1. Use metadata to interpret a dataset.
  2. Combine records using a meaningful shared key.
  3. Distinguish missing, invalid, repeated and unusual values.
  4. Apply explained rules and preserve an audit trail.

Deliver a cleaned view + an exclusion log + one limitation.
note: 不把 usable 解释成“整齐”“平均数更合理”。要求学生最终说明每条规则为何适合本次分钟分析，并能从原始数据重现结果。清洗与筛选都是程序可以帮助完成的操作，但分析责任仍在设计规则的人。

title: Data and data about data
html:
Primary data in this surveyMetadata about the survey
One response reports 28.The field measures one-way time in minutes.
One response reports “Bus”.Allowed mode labels: Walk, Bike, Bus.
Rows contain response IDs.How the responses were collected and defined.

Metadata help us interpret, find, organize and manage data.

元数据提供说明；行中的观测值是本表的主要数据。
note: 区分一个字段的值与描述字段的规则。例如一行里的 Bus 是主要数据，“mode 是主要出行方式，允许哪些标签”是元数据。元数据也可以被单独研究成另一个数据集；本课先固定当前通勤表的语境。

title: Changing a label does not convert a value
html:
A stored value is 30; its unit is minutes.

Someone changes only the unit label to “hours”.

  1. Has the stored number changed?
  2. What value would represent the same duration in hours?
Show answer
1. No: the primary value is still 30. The new label misdescribes it.
2. 0.5 hours. A real conversion changes the numeric value and updates the unit together.

改元数据不等于转换主要数据。
note: 先复习 CED 对元数据和主要数据的区分：只改描述不会自动变更观测值。改标签虽然不改数字，却可能导致错误解释。30 分钟为 0.5 小时属于可独立手算的单位换算；实验室不会替学生自动推断单位。

title: Know where the records came from
html:
Our source: Fictional Campus Commute Survey

  • Synthetic classroom records, not actual students.
  • A fictional voluntary survey at one school, one morning.
  • Fields: response ID, mode, minutes and distance in km.

Keep the source, collection context, field meanings and changes with the data.

A clean table still needs a description of who or what it represents.
note: 解释 provenance 为来源与处理来历，不需要记专业数据库术语。把合成数据的性质直接讲给学生。单校单晨自愿样本的限制将在 L08 展开；本课先指出标签统一不可能自动把它变成所有学校的代表性样本。

title: Combine by a key, not by row position
html:
Table A

IDMinutes
0225
0312

Table B

IDDistance (km)
030.8
024.0

Match each travel time to the correct distance.

Show matched records
02 → 25 minutes, 4.0 km.   03 → 12 minutes, 0.8 km.
The shared response ID identifies the match even when row order differs.
note: 这两张小表是主数据集字段拆分后的教学例子，不是新调查证据。逐行拼接会把 25 与 0.8 错配。让学生用纸线连接相同 ID。这里的 key 是共享标识符；不要求 SQL 或数据库键理论。

title: A matching label is not enough
html:
1. Does the ID mean the same thing in both sources?
  2. Is each intended match unique?
  3. Do the field definitions, units and time periods agree?
  4. What will you do with an unmatched or conflicting record?

“03” from two unrelated surveys need not identify the same response.

Resolve uncertainty or record it; do not invent a match.
note: 学生可能认为“有同名列就能拼接”。强调标识符需要共享的发放规则，不能把两个学校都出现的 03 当同一人。重复 key 可能导致一个记录匹配多个值；先调查，不随意选有利的一条。单位不同时必须明确换算而不是改表头。

title: Inspect the raw table first
html:
16 raw rows. Is every row ready for a time analysis?

Look at IDs 09, 10, 03, 14, 15.

  1. Read the field definitions.
  2. Find a missing value, an invalid value and an exact repeat.
  3. Separate a label problem from a questionable measurement.

Open the Data Lab → Data tab · Read the source dataset and rules
note: 先只看 raw，不应用规则。16 是行数，不是 16 个不同 ID；ID 03 重复出现。提醒 id 是字符串，应保留前导零。学生可在纸上圈注问题并提出问题，暂不删除任何原始记录。

title: Describe the problem precisely
html:
ObservationProblem type
ID 09: minutes is blankMissing measurement
ID 10: minutes = −5Invalid elapsed travel time
ID 03 appears twice identicallyRepeated record
ID 15: mode is “ bus ”Inconsistent formatting

Different problems need different decisions.

缺失 · 无效 · 重复 · 格式不一致
note: 先遮住第二列让学生分类，再逐项揭晓或口头核对。数据质量并不只有“数值太大”一种问题。−5 无效的理由来自“经过的单程分钟数”这个语义；在温度等其他字段，负数未必无效。

title: Normalize equivalent labels
html:
“ bus ” → “Bus”

Remove extra spaces; use the agreed capitalization.

  1. Does this create a new travel mode?
  2. Should “Bike” also become “Bus” to simplify the table?
Show answer
1. No. The label still means Bus.
2. No. Bike and Bus have different meanings. Combining them would lose a meaningful distinction.

统一等价表达，不能为了整齐改写事实。
note: 这一步最直接对应 DAT-2.C.4。让学生判断 BUS、Bus、前后空格等可按明确映射统一，而 Bicycle 是否等价需要字段定义支持，不能单靠拼写相似猜测。此数据集仅需把 id15 的“ bus ”标准化为 Bus。

title: Missing does not mean zero
html:
ID 09 has no reported travel time.

A. Replace the blank with 0.

B. Preserve the blank in raw data; exclude this row from the current time analysis and log why.

Choose and justify
B follows the stated rule. A would invent a zero-minute measurement. Missing means unknown, not “no travel time”.

The raw response remains available for review or another suitable question.
note: 区分保留原始行与从当前分析视图排除。这里不教插补算法，不让学生用均值或相邻值填空。其他研究可以依据事先说明的方法处理缺失，但本数据集明确采用排除并记录。只有 mode 的计数问题可能有不同纳入规则，提醒清洗决定依赖分析目的。

title: A plausible correction still needs evidence
html:
ID 10 reports −5 minutes of elapsed travel.

  1. Why is it invalid for this field?
  2. Can we assume the intended value was +5?
  3. What does the stated rule require?
Show answer
Elapsed travel time cannot be negative. The intended value is unknown; changing it to +5 would be a guess. Preserve the raw row, exclude it from this analysis, and record the reason.
note: 让学生给出字段层面的检查，而不是笼统“负数不允许”。类比 L04 的有效输入范围：检查规则来自需求。不要把取绝对值当成通用清洗。若真实调查能回访，可寻求更正并记录来源；本虚构案例没有额外证据。

title: An identical repeat or a conflict?
html:
Our two rows for ID 03 both report Walk, 12 minutes, 0.8 km.

Keep the first copy; exclude the later identical copy and log it.

Suppose a second row instead said 30 minutes.

Would the same automatic rule be enough?
No. Conflicting values need investigation. Check the source and collection rules, then document a decision or flag the conflict. Do not silently choose the preferred value.

相同 ID 但内容冲突时，先核查。
note: 主数据集第二个 id03 是所有字段均相同的重复行，所以按既定规则保留第一条。30 分钟是反事实讨论，不要把它改写进共享数据。真实场景中相同人的不同日期通勤未必重复，必须先定义“一行代表什么”。

title: Unusual does not automatically mean wrong
html:
ID 14 reports 120 minutes and 5 km.

  1. Is 120 impossible under the field definition?
  2. What evidence would justify correcting or excluding it?
Default decision
Keep 120 and flag it as unusual. A delay or unusual journey is possible. A verified entry mistake or a stated eligibility rule could justify a later change; surprise alone is not enough.

L08 will compare an optional “without 120” view as a sensitivity check.
note: 严禁为让图形、均值好看而自动删掉 120。120 对该字段并无预设上限冲突，距离与时间组合值得核查但不能证明错误。实验室去掉 120 的开关仅供下一课敏感性探索，不属于默认清洗；默认应保留 id14。

title: Write rules before seeing the answer
html:
1. Keep an unchanged raw copy.
  2. Standardize equivalent mode labels.
  3. Keep one copy of identical repeated responses.
  4. Exclude missing or negative times from this analysis.
  5. Retain 120; record the unusual-value flag.

Log row ID, original issue, action and reason.

A cleaning log makes decisions reviewable and repeatable.
note: 要求同桌检查规则是否改变了量的含义，是否能由另一人重复执行。标准化是保留语义的清洗；删除分析视图中的行属于有明确理由的筛选，应和“改写原始观测”区分。仅剩 13 行并不能证明规则正确，还需要核对具体被排除的行。

title: Predict the clean view
html:
In the Data Lab → Data tab, inspect the 16 raw rows.

  1. Write the IDs of the rows to exclude, with reasons.
  2. Identify the label to normalize.
  3. Predict the number of retained rows.
  4. Explain what should happen to ID 14.

Keep the optional “exclude 120” exploration off.
Each student writes a prediction before applying the rules.
note: 六分钟任务：前两分钟独立写，接着同伴核对，最后确认能指出每条原始行。ID 03 重复要注明“后出现的同样副本”，不能把两条都删掉。不要先让计数器显示答案再补写预测。学生不会编码也可利用现成工具实行透明规则，本课不要求写列表清洗程序。

title: Check the rows, not just the count
html:
Apply the stated cleaning rules. Compare with your prediction.

CheckExpected evidence
Rows16 raw → 13 retained
Excluded09: missing; 10: negative; later 03: identical repeat
NormalizedID 15: “ bus ” → Bus
Retained and flaggedID 14: 120 minutes

Save a brief explanation of any prediction you changed.
note: 让一人读日志，另一人核对原始表和输出表。16−1−1−1=13；标准化模式不减少行数，120 未被排除。若意外得到 12，先检查敏感性开关；若得到 14，找漏掉的问题。清洗规则对错误数据也可能被错误实现，要用实际行验证。

title: Collect what the question needs
html:
The question is: “How do reported commute times vary by travel mode?”

  1. Do we need names, birth dates or exact home addresses?
  2. What could linking a location or timestamp to an ID reveal?
  3. Suggest a smaller, useful collection plan.
One defensible plan
Collect the needed mode and time fields, explain the purpose, and use a response ID only as needed. Avoid unnecessary identifying details. An ID alone does not guarantee anonymity when datasets are linked.
note: 本表完全合成，所以无需学生提交自己的真实地址或通勤信息。隐私讨论使用假设场景，不开展真人调查。距离字段可服务下一课另一个明确问题；若当前只比较方式与时间，不应为了“以后也许有用”无限扩收。这里是负责任实践延伸，不宣称已覆盖整个 IOC 隐私单元。

title: Cleaning cannot repair every limitation
html:
A voluntary survey may miss people who did not respond.

A. Standardize labels, then claim every student is represented.

B. State the collection limits even after cleaning.

Show answer
B. Consistent labels and valid values do not guarantee a representative sample. Adding more responses from the same biased source may leave the bias in place.

Our fictional one-school, one-morning sample is practice data, not evidence about all commuters.
note: 用两个问题区别 quality 与 representativeness：值是否可用，来源是否适合推论。不要说样本小必然错误；要说自愿参与和单次来源可能造成选择偏差，增加同源数据不能自动消除。深入抽样解释和图表结论安排 L08。

title: Which TWO decisions preserve the evidence?
html:
A. Replace a missing time with 0 without evidence.

B. Keep raw data and record each exclusion.

C. Remove 120 only because it looks high.

D. Standardize “ bus ” to Bus using the field definition.

Show answer and explain the others
B and D. A invents a measurement. C treats an unusual value as a proven error. B preserves the source and decisions; D preserves the label’s meaning.

Select exactly TWO. This is original classroom practice.
note: 不要只看选项字母：要求一组解释 A，另一组解释 C 的错误假设。指出 B 的作用是可追溯，不保证所有原始数据都正确。D 只因字段定义确认等价才合理；不能随意合并不同类别。

title: Write a defensible cleaning statement
html:
Complete the three-part explanation:

  1. “We began with ___ raw rows and retained ___.”
  2. “We excluded ___, standardized ___, and retained ___ because ___.”
  3. “This does not establish ___ about all students.”
Model summary
16 → 13. Exclude 09, 10 and the later identical 03; normalize ID 15 to Bus; retain 120 because no error is established. The voluntary sample does not establish a school-wide or universal pattern.

Homework: 12 original questions · 30 classroom marks · about 40 minutes.
note: 让学生使用自己的句子，保留原因而不是抄写编号串。当前只有课堂模拟数据，不能声称真的发现学校现象。学生报告中还需写数据来源为 synthetic。不要在这页引出均值谁最高，避免超过本课范围。

title: Exit ticket: meaning, rules and evidence
html:
1. Is “travel time is measured in minutes” data or metadata about this table?
  2. Why must a missing time not silently become 0?
  3. Should 120 be removed by the default rules?
  4. How many rows remain, and what proves the count is justified?
Teacher check
1. Metadata. 2. Unknown is not a measured zero.
3. No; retain and flag it. 4. 13; check the three excluded rows and reasons in the log against the raw data.
note: 每项一分，第四项要求 13 和核对日志/原始记录的理由，单写 13 不足。建议 3/4 且不能把缺失当零者进入 L08；若第 2 或 3 项错，先做两例对比练习。下一课将使用同一 13 行视图进行分析，再单独展示敏感性视图。
